description: Build a pre-filled booking link from known trip details for the user to review and submit. Returns a URL only: it does NOT submit a booking. The booking is a request confirmed by a human afterwards. The pickup must respect the minimum notice (Madrid time, longer at night, and it depends on the vehicle category; https://privyde.com/developers#lead-time), which the booking form checks.

lang.description: Language for names and URLs. Defaults to "es".
